conclusion: The proposed successor repair is a sound, minimal projection at the only confirmed producer-consumer loss boundary. Implementation is approved only with the unchanged strict consumer, receipt/stat/hash provenance, real initial and successor parent-to-child composition, and all listed near-miss regressions.
design_assessment: The failure boundary is correctly isolated to the sole reachable supervisor child call: the verified compact parent has an integer ledger_rows beside a strict path/SHA/stat ledger_ref, but _run_frozen_group forwards only the latter.

The proposed selector {**parent[ledger_ref], rows: parent[ledger_rows]} is the minimum semantic repair. It copies rows only after _read_compact_parent and all existing manifest/core/graph/process/lock/lease checks, preserves the original receipt and stat/hash witness, and leaves the strict bridge loader unchanged.

The design correctly keeps generic StageRef/_ref shape, compact receipt serialization, exact inventory/stat equality, stable snapshot reads, runtime row/hash/stat checks, source closure, authorization, resource, clock, attempt, namespace, and child-ready guards unchanged.

The reachable-transition audit correctly finds no analogous successor loss: _stage_ledger creates a fresh rows-bearing selector for each successor. The implementation must derive rows from each verified current receipt rather than hardcode 89 or reuse the initial prefix.

The actual qualification only constructed S0 and twenty command specifications, so it did not exercise _run_frozen_group/create_child_stage. The required real composition therefore closes a genuine untested producer-consumer seam.
implementation_conditions: Implement only the successor supervisor call-boundary projection in the fresh BF23 namespace; do not edit frozen BF22 bridge17, stage-runtime09, receipt writer, generic refs, or runtime row/hash/stat gates.

Use the already verified parent ledger_ref and parent ledger_rows; require the existing positive-int/equality guards to remain authoritative and never derive a count from live bytes or silently accept missing rows.

Preserve all BF22 source/core/manifest/contract/ledger/attempt/clock/resource/namespace/history evidence and bind any BF23 source/contract/closure hashes only after actual source collection and independent review. Do not invent future hashes or claim BF23 qualification.
Keep the failed BF22 launch namespace and receipts as immutable evidence; the root stop accounting reports no attempt consumed and must not be reinterpreted.
limitations: This approval is implementation-only for the narrow successor supervisor projection and harmless regression tests. It is not source-commit, build, admission, qualification, replay, analyzer, launch, retry, or release approval.
BF23 requires fresh source closure, core/contract/manifest reviews, focused tests, actual qualification invocation review, and independent terminal evidence after implementation.
No implementation, source mutation, Git mutation, build, replay, admission, analyzer, launch, or production operation was performed by this review.

observed_failure.consumer: supervisor22._run_frozen_group passes parent[ledger_ref] without rows to bridge17.create_child_stage; bridge17._load_bound_ledger_runtime rejects the missing typed row count before runtime acquisition.
observed_failure.producer: compact parent receipt intentionally stores ledger_ref as path/SHA/stat and ledger_rows separately; changing StageRef or receipt serialization would widen the repair unnecessarily.

prospective_successor_boundary.historical_namespace: Fresh BF23 qualification/launcher/bootstrap/config/source namespaces; never reuse failed BF22 execution namespace.
prospective_successor_boundary.source_inputs: Current BF22 actual 1,678 roster plus 17 successor source/test paths only after actual Git collection and review; no future hashes inferred.

required_regressions.requirement: Real compact parent receipt without nested rows plus separate ledger_rows=89 flows through actual supervisor _run_frozen_group, actual create_child_stage, actual _load_bound_ledger_runtime, real child construction, and both child-ready checks before a downstream analyzer sentinel.
A real one-row successor receipt reaches rows=90 through the same path; test derives 90 from that receipt and compares inventory path/SHA/stat tuples before and after.
The original unadapted ledger_ref fails at the unchanged strict consumer before runtime acquisition; a sentinel proves no downstream bypass.
Missing, bool, string, zero, and mismatched positive counts are rejected by existing predicates before runtime acquisition.
Changed bytes, hash, stat, path, same-content foreign path, and stale witness are rejected without refreshing witnesses.
Changed receipt identity, source/plan/contract/manifest/core/graph/namespace, and stale parent references are rejected by the actual compact-parent/ready guards.

The regression uses actual production-mode _run_frozen_group and launcher-derived environment; it does not replace create_child_stage, _load_bound_ledger_runtime, or child-ready guards with mocks. Only downstream evidence acquisition/analyzer dispatch may be bounded by an explicit fixture sentinel.
